title: Create: Hammers
description: Adds the ability to create sheets via your inventory, without having to go to a press to make sheets.
body:
![Create: Hammers](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8fc92276321de2aeb5b1aa03ec8357ca99df4540.png)
# Create: Hammers
Adds the ability to make Create sheets with diamond, iron, and stone hammers.

This mod is designed only for 1.21.1, however it might work with other versions. I may eventually update it to include other versions.
